agreement: Maintainer, 3 Nov 2026: 14:40 agreement to recompile MoltenVK or replace its kept binary; 15:04 go-ahead for this workflow and its runs; 15:23 'keep the latest MoltenVK library, the most recent one'.
why: v1.4.2 (newest Khronos release) enables MTLResidencySet on iOS 18 (mvkOSVersionIsAtLeast(15.0, 18.0, 2.0), Apple6 GPUs) and defers useResource in deduplicated lists, which removes upstream the per-descriptor walk measured in 629; the RewindBox argument buffer patch written for 1.4.0 no longer applies and is retired. MVKConfiguration is unchanged from 1.4.0.
